command:
set -eu
echo '=== VOICE ==='
systemctl --user show frankenstein-gespraechsmodus.service -p ActiveState -p SubState -p MainPID -p ExecMainStartTimestamp -p ExecStart --no-pager || true
echo '=== CHATGPT CLIENT ==='
systemctl --user show frankenstein-chatgpt-client.service -p ActiveState -p SubState -p MainPID -p ExecMainStartTimestamp -p ExecStart --no-pager || true
echo '=== OMNI ==='
systemctl --user show frankenstein-omni.service -p ActiveState -p SubState -p MainPID -p ExecMainStartTimestamp --no-pager || true
echo '=== INSTALLED BYTES ==='
for f in omega_arm_bus.py omega_organ_activity.py voice777_local_audio_arm.py voice777_omni_presence.py voice777_pocket_renderer.py voice_full_runtime.py frank_terminal.py voice_777_runtime.py voice_host_777_live_client.py frank_terminal_777.py; do sha256sum "$HOME/.local/lib/frankenstein/scripts/$f"; done
echo '=== OMEGA RUNTIME CACHE ==='
cat "${XDG_RUNTIME_DIR:-/run/user/$(id -u)}/frankenstein/omega_organ_activity.json" 2>/dev/null || echo NO_ORGAN_ACTIVITY_CACHE
echo '=== ARM DIR ==='
ls -la /tmp/omega-arm 2>/dev/null || true
find /tmp/omega-arm -maxdepth 1 -type f -printf '%f %s %TY-%Tm-%TdT%TH:%TM:%TS\n' 2>/dev/null || true
echo OMEGA_LIVE_ACTIVATION_PREFLIGHT_DONE=1
